entries.title: Job 18:1
segments: ¶Then Bildad the Shuhite made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 18:2
segments: How long will it be before you have done talking? Get wisdom, and then we will say what is in our minds.

entries.title: Job 18:3
segments: Why do we seem as beasts in your eyes, and as completely without knowledge?

entries.title: Job 18:4
segments: But come back, now, come: you who are wounding yourself in your passion, will the earth be given up because of you, or a rock be moved out of its place?

entries.title: Job 18:5
segments: ¶For the light of the sinner is put out, and the flame of his fire is not shining.

entries.title: Job 18:6
segments: The light is dark in his tent, and the light shining over him is put out.

entries.title: Job 18:7
segments: The steps of his strength become short, and by his design destruction overtakes him.

entries.title: Job 18:8
segments: His feet take him into the net, and he goes walking into the cords.

entries.title: Job 18:9
segments: His foot is taken in the net; he comes into its grip.

entries.title: Job 18:10
segments: The twisted cord is put secretly in the earth to take him, and the cord is placed in his way.

entries.title: Job 18:11
segments: ¶He is overcome by fears on every side, they go after him at every step.

entries.title: Job 18:12
segments: His strength is made feeble for need of food, and destruction is waiting for his falling footstep.

entries.title: Job 18:13
segments: His skin is wasted by disease, and his body is food for the worst of diseases.

entries.title: Job 18:14
segments: He is pulled out of his tent where he was safe, and he is taken away to the king of fears.

entries.title: Job 18:15
segments: In his tent will be seen that which is not his, burning stone is dropped on his house.

entries.title: Job 18:16
segments: Under the earth his roots are dry, and over it his branch is cut off.

entries.title: Job 18:17
segments: His memory is gone from the earth, and in the open country there is no knowledge of his name.

entries.title: Job 18:18
segments: He is sent away from the light into the dark; he is forced out of the world.

entries.title: Job 18:19
segments: He has no offspring or family among his people, and in his living-place there is no one of his name.

entries.title: Job 18:20
segments: At his fate those of the west are shocked, and those of the east are overcome with fear.

entries.title: Job 18:21
segments: Truly, these are the houses of the sinner, and this is the place of him who has no knowledge of God.
